slides.title: Overnight in Ethiopia: fighting in central Tigray
Clashes near Mirena
slides.body: Fighting on Oct. 17-18 came as federal troops tried to advance toward Adet, the TPLF said, according to Anadolu.

slides.title: A disputed death toll
slides.body: A TPLF official claimed over 1,500 federal soldiers were killed. Anadolu said it could not verify this. The government had not commented.

slides.title: Abiy appeals to fighters
slides.body: In an Oct. 19 address in Tigrinya, the prime minister urged fighters to lay down arms and warned of legal accountability, Borkena reported.

slides.title: Civilian toll unknown
slides.body: Neither report gave civilian casualty figures. Independent access and verification in Tigray remain limited.

slides.title: Protect civilians. Allow independent monitors in.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.
